summary: To sync an execution environment from a remote registry into private automation hub, first configure the remote registry (for example https://registry.redhat.io) with credentials and an optional rate limit under Advanced Options, then Create execution environment, choosing the registry, the local Name and the Upstream name of the image.
questions: How do I sync an execution environment from registry.redhat.io into automation hub?
